description: This source file defines server-side load and action functions for the organization selection page in a SvelteKit application. It handles fetching user organizations via a Django REST API endpoint, managing authentication tokens stored in cookies, and switching organization context by requesting a new token set from the server. The file includes logic for redirecting on errors and updating cookies accordingly.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the current user's organizations from the Django API, utilizing JWT authentication stored in cookies. Returns an array of organizations with their IDs, names, logos, and roles.

methods.name: actions.selectOrg
methods.description: Handles the organization switching process by calling the Django API to obtain new JWT tokens with the selected organization context, updates cookies accordingly, and redirects to the main page.
